lines.text: Many learners say: Do you like coffee? Yes, I like.
Better: Do you like coffee? Yes, I do.

data.wrong: Do you like coffee? Yes, I like.
data.right: Do you like coffee? Yes, I do.

options: Do you like pizza? Yes, I like.

native.tip: Em respostas curtas, repita o auxiliar: “Yes, I do”, não “Yes, I like”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Do you like coffee? Yes, I like.” O certo é “Do you like coffee? Yes, I do.” Em português respondemos só “gosto”, mas em inglês a resposta curta usa “do”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.

en.tip: In short answers, repeat the helper word: “Yes, I do”, not “Yes, I like”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Do you like coffee? Yes, I like.” The right way is “Do you like coffee? Yes, I do.” In Portuguese we answer just “gosto”, but the short English answer uses “do”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
